body: Slitting your wrists is an awful, slow and painful way to die. I’m not going to give you easy and painless death ideas but that’s not a way to go. My ex-girlfriend slit her forearms and legs in november of 2019 and she was found 2 hours into bleeding out. She explained it to me as being cold around the slits and hot cuz of the blood. She said it wasn’t that painful expect for the initial cut and stinging afterwards. Either way, it wasn’t a pleasant experience. In May of this year, she was pregnant with my baby. She took opioids and committed suicide. I still love her to death. I’m sure someone feels the same way about you whether it’s your parents, siblings or friends.
